note: Frozen game of the golden traces (mission M35). Every entry is replayed by the seeded simulator (build/relais-simulate), whose journal is normalised then hashed with SHA-256 (tools/golden/traces.json). The 'published' entries replay the scenarios of the repository (scenarios/*.json); the 'golden' entries cover the behaviours the published set does not reach. Seeds, faults and parameters are frozen: changing any of them changes the trace, and the trace is only refreshed on purpose (make golden-update).

scenarios.name: published/slalom-nominal
scenarios.note: nominal: the holder commands every tick, no fault, the reference of the others (CMD-01)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-death-A
scenarios.note: the holder dies: the actuator revokes on its own proof, the second takes over (MAN-04, REL-01)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-death-B
scenarios.note: the second dies: the redundancy is lost, the lamp turns yellow, the command continues (DEG-01)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-double-death
scenarios.note: both machines die: beyond the single-fault hypothesis the claim is the safe state (spec 3.3)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-freeze-A-200ms
scenarios.note: the holder is frozen for 200 ms: silence detected, handover on the proof (MAN-04)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-freeze-B-1s
scenarios.note: the second is frozen for 1 s: the certification is lost, then recovered (DEG-07)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-cut-A-to-actuator
scenarios.note: link machine -> actuator cut: the holder cannot command, the second is appointed (REL-03)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-cut-between-computers
scenarios.note: link between the two computers cut: the shadow is lost, the certification expires (DEG-06)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-slow-machine
scenarios.note: slow machine: one tick out of three is lost, the loop still closes (ROB-03)

scenarios.name: published/slalom-sweep-death-all-phases
scenarios.note: campaign template of the sweep: the instant of the death is swept over the whole period

scenarios.name: published/rolling-update
scenarios.note: both machines updated in turn: clean cession, reboot, re-certification (REL-10, DEG-03, DEG-07)

scenarios.name: golden/nominal-socle
scenarios.note: level S: no shadow, the handover goes through the will (REL-03)

scenarios.name: golden/cession-holder
scenarios.note: the holder cedes voluntarily: the handover costs one tick (REL-09)

scenarios.name: golden/dissimilar-second
scenarios.note: dissimilar second: the gap inside the published band certifies a DISSIMILAR backup, the handover admits the dissimilar_delta bump (DEG-08)

scenarios.name: golden/mismatch-second
scenarios.note: the second computes wrong: three ticks above epsilon, the disagreement is reported and the certification is dropped (DET-09)

scenarios.name: golden/sweep-death-phase-0
scenarios.note: sweep of the handover, phase 0 of 5 (T = 5 ms)

scenarios.name: golden/sweep-death-phase-1
scenarios.note: sweep of the handover, phase 1 of 5

scenarios.name: golden/sweep-death-phase-2
scenarios.note: sweep of the handover, phase 2 of 5

scenarios.name: golden/sweep-death-phase-3
scenarios.note: sweep of the handover, phase 3 of 5

scenarios.name: golden/sweep-death-phase-4
scenarios.note: sweep of the handover, phase 4 of 5: every phase of the period is covered

scenarios.name: golden/forge-order
scenarios.note: the second forges an order with the current mandate: it is dropped (SEC-04)

scenarios.name: golden/forge-stale
scenarios.note: the holder replays an order of a past tick: it is dropped (ACT-09)

scenarios.name: golden/lossy-delay
scenarios.note: lossy channel with jitter: the claim is the safe state, not the continuity (ROB-02, ROB-03)

scenarios.name: golden/crash-proc
scenarios.note: a process of the holder dies: the machine cedes in the same tick (DET-05, QNX-06)

scenarios.name: golden/restart
scenarios.note: a machine restarts: it comes back empty and must be certified again (DEG-03, ROB-06)

scenarios.name: golden/cut-restore
scenarios.note: the link is cut then restored: the certification is lost, then recovered (DEG-06, DEG-07)
